summary_1line: After recovering from unconsciousness, Pradyumna rebukes his charioteer for retreating and insists on returning to battle against Salwa to preserve honor.

image_candidates.scene_text: Pradyumna, wounded and newly revived, stands in his chariot angrily commanding his charioteer to turn back toward the battlefield.
The charioteer whips and reins the horses as the chariot wheels in sweeping arcs, the steeds seeming to fly through the dust of the battlefield.
